hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the catalogue pod will cause the catalogue browse step to fail, breaking the golden journey.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: catalogue is a single-replica workload and is directly required for the catalogue browse step.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: catalogue browse returns HTTP 200 and JSON array.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/catalogue, then execute catalogue browse step and check response.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Pod is restarted by Kubernetes; after recovery, catalogue browse returns to baseline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the front-end pod will cause all golden journey steps to fail, as front-end is the entry point.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: front-end is the single entry point for all business steps.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: All steps return HTTP 200/201 and satisfy contracts.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/front-end, then execute all steps and check responses.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Pod is restarted; after recovery, all steps return to baseline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the user pod will cause the login step to fail, breaking the authenticated orders journey.

hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/user, then execute login step and check response.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Pod is restarted; after recovery, login returns to baseline.
